in_hebrew.name: Mollie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mary's little one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mollie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Molly, a diminutive of Mary. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus.

in_greek.name: Mollie
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mary's little one
in_greek.long_meaning: Mollie είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Molly, a diminutive of Mary. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus.

in_latin.name: Mollie
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mary's little one
in_latin.long_meaning: Mollie est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Molly, a diminutive of Mary. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus.
